description: Compare VerifyLeader completion with a conservative bound on eligible contributions after all old append responses have been consumed. Independent permitted voter control and nonvoter-only schedule use fresh real clusters.

harness.description: TestAssuranceVerifyEligibleSupport generates real elections and a completed command in each four-node cluster, verifies public member IDs/roles, pauses the selected leader's two append workers per remote peer at next call, invokes public VerifyLeader, releases all peers or only the nonvoter, and observes that same Future.Error. Result counts are measured distinct positive RPC returns, with self included as allowed by registration.
semantic_changes: Only test transport adaptation: disable optional pipeline using ErrPipelineReplicationNotSupported; apply finite outgoing request delays before actual InmemTransport.AppendEntries.
No implementation code replacement or critical protocol state assignment. FSM returns applied command bytes to establish prefix completion.
Result support is an upper bound on real positive voter contributions, not a synthetic response or inferred result from packet delivery.
Five-second observation timeout emits incomplete without a completed event; cleanup releases requests independently of the property.

legality.derivation: Construct four actual nodes through BootstrapCluster/NewRaft using validated unique IDs and explicit roles. A transport wrapper returns the documented ErrPipelineReplicationNotSupported, selecting existing ordinary replication. It pauses outgoing AppendEntries before delivery and delegates released calls unchanged to InmemTransport. Error-free reply observations are actual returned fields. No direct writes to term, role, membership, log, future or replication state occur. All paused calls are released during unconditional cleanup.
legality.applicability: A non-Byzantine in-memory transport variant with finite request delays. The real two-worker ownership in replicate/heartbeat and serial AppendEntries calls make next-call arrival a quiescence observation. Normal data requests are distinguishable from prefix-free heartbeat requests after the nonzero committed startup prefix.
unresolved: This variant does not exercise pipelining or fast heartbeat callbacks.
No crash-durable backend, restart, user restore or live membership change is included.
alternatives: Snapshot sender is excluded by the small un-compacted generated prefix and no available snapshot; real log catch-up handles bootstrap differences.
No timers or protective workers are disabled; the configured two-second lease bounds pending verification without being a property deadline.

grounding.derivation: Encode only the necessary implication: successful public verification implies that enough eligible voter support could have contributed. The harness counts distinct voters whose real AppendEntries returns were positive, plus self. This is an upper bound on consumed eligible support, so success with an upper bound below quorum violates the necessary condition; sufficient possible support alone does not prove correct consumption.
grounding.applicability: Fixed three-voter/one-nonvoter configuration. A completed Apply establishes a generated prefix. Both synchronous append workers for every remote peer reach a transport-entry pause before public admission, eliminating prior outstanding responses in those workers. No protocol state is assigned.
unresolved: No stale application read or conflicting decision endpoint is observed.
Transport errors and leases can instead cause legitimate failure; bounded absence of completion remains incomplete.
alternatives: Control releases every peer; potential voter-majority support permits success but does not require it.
Nonvoter-only schedule leaves main-loop lease expiry, elections, and negative-response logic running.
The checker uses an upper bound, so excess counted but unconsumed responses can hide a violation, not create one.

observable_properties.description: For each admitted operation, nil public completion requires at least a possible eligible voter quorum. Self plus only nonvoter returns yields eligible_support_possible=false; a failure or pending operation is not required to become success.

uncertainties: The obligation is a derived authority-check support condition, not an explicit voter-quorum sentence in the API.
Actual result and attribution require trusted execution and correspondence review.
This checker cannot prove all eligible acknowledgements were consumed; it only detects success when even their upper bound is insufficient.
A timeout does not establish a liveness failure or bounded holds; the corresponding admitted operation remains incomplete.
Snapshot and pipelined support producers remain unexercised independent variants.
